producthunt.name: Motionflare
producthunt.tagline: Turn your website into a stunning launch video in minutes
producthunt.description: Motionflare turns your website into a ready-to-share marketing video and brand film in minutes. Paste a URL and it uses your real product screenshots, logo, colors, and copy to create branded motion graphics with music and optional narration. Or switch to Film mode to generate a live-action commercial. Refine the result by chat and export in up to 4K.

producthunt.name: AlterContacts
producthunt.tagline: AI client relationship assistant that thinks and does ahead
producthunt.description: AlterContacts is a voice-first AI assistant that helps you remember every client and never miss an important follow-up. Just talk about your meeting, and Alter organizes the details, updates the client's profile, and remembers what you promised. It notices upcoming renewals, personal milestones, and relationships that need attention, then prepares your next message for approval. Built for financial advisors, brokers, and consultants who care about relationships, not CRM data entry.
